Since both lines pass through the circle’s center, \(AC\) and \(BD\) are diameters of length \(4\).  
The slopes are \(-\frac12\) and \(2\), so the diameters are perpendicular.  
Thus \(ABCD\) is a square with diagonals \(4\), so its area is

\[
\frac12 \cdot 4 \cdot 4 = 8.
\]

\[
\boxed{8}
\]
